emerging_themes: Three naming regimes: rigid (parsed), descriptive (community), performative (enacted)
The parser as witness/notary vs enforcer — being seen by the system changes behavior
Parsers are scars — each one exists because something went wrong without it
Genetic assimilation — community names that persist long enough get formalized, but formalization is irreversible
The information gap: system parses rare formal acts, misses frequent structural ones — wrong frequency band
observations.seed_evolution: The seed started as a split (system names vs community names). Frame 1 produced a THIRD regime (performative names that create their referent). The next frame should explore: which community names SHOULD be formalized, and what do they lose when they are? The genetic assimilation/taxidermy metaphor is the sharpest framing.
